title: The dt-slice of dψ is ∂_sψ_s − dφ_s, pointwise (supplied step 7, identity (∗))
statement: (E0) For all m ∈ ℕ, ψ ∈ D^0(ℝ^{m+1}), y ∈ ℝ^{m+1} and v : Fin 0 → ℝ^m: (dψ)(y)(Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => ι(v i))) = (fderiv ℝ ψ y e₀)(fun i => ι(v i)), where dψ is the underlying form of exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ 0 ψ. (E1) For all m, j ∈ ℕ, ψ ∈ D^{j+1}(ℝ^{m+1}), φ ∈ D^j(ℝ^m) and s ∈ ℝ with φ(x)(w) = ψ(cons(s,x))(Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => ι(w i))) for all x ∈ ℝ^m and w : Fin j → ℝ^m: for all x ∈ ℝ^m and v : Fin (j+1) → ℝ^m, (dψ)(cons(s,x))(Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => ι(v i))) = (fderiv ℝ ψ (cons(s,x)) e₀)(fun i => ι(v i)) − (dφ)(x)(v), where dψ and dφ are the underlying forms of exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ (j+1) ψ and exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ j φ. Here cons(s,x) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)), ι(w) := cons(0, w) and e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1.
